canDoYue: 你識問自助餐係咪任食、汽水包唔包、邊啲菜有貝殼類，同埋一次攞一碟。
canDoEn: Ask whether the buffet is eat-in, whether soft drinks are included, which dishes have shellfish, and whether you may take one plate at a time.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Is this buffet all you can eat, and is takeaway banned?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個自助餐係咪任食，而且唔可以拎走？
dialogue.say: Is this buffet all you can eat, and is takeaway banned?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Yes. This buffet is for here only, so takeaway is banned.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。呢個自助餐只可以堂食，所以唔可以拎走。
dialogue.say: Yes. This buffet is for here only, so takeaway is banned.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Are soft drinks included, or do I pay for each one?
dialogue.glossYue: 汽水係咪包咗，定係要逐杯畀錢？
dialogue.say: Are soft drinks included, or do I pay for each one?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Yes. Those soft drinks are included for every adult at the table.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。每位成人喺檯上都包汽水。
dialogue.say: Yes. Those soft drinks are included for every adult at the table.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Which hot dishes have shellfish, and may I have a clean plate?
dialogue.glossYue: 邊啲熱菜有貝殼類？可唔可以畀個乾淨碟我？
dialogue.say: Which hot dishes have shellfish, and may I have a clean plate?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: The prawn soup has shellfish, so here is a clean plate.
dialogue.glossYue: 蝦湯有貝殼類，所以呢個係乾淨碟。
dialogue.say: The prawn soup has shellfish, so here is a clean plate.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I come back for a second serving after this one?
dialogue.glossYue: 我食完呢份可唔可以再攞第二次？
dialogue.say: Can I come back for a second serving after this one?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Yes. A second serving is fine once that one is finished.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。食完呢份就可以再攞。
dialogue.say: Yes. A second serving is fine once that one is finished.
